# The Car Bath

> Mobile and on-site car wash, valet and detailing business in Cape Town, South Africa. Comes to homes and offices, works on site at business parks and apartment blocks on a set day, and takes drop-offs by appointment at 27 Honeyside Rd W, Frere Estate, Cape Town. 5.0 stars from 21 Google reviews (November 2026). In business for 4+ years, with public liability insurance.

## Key facts

- Essential Wash: R180. Exterior wash and dry, tyre shine, window cleaning, interior vacuum, dashboard and surfaces wiped.
- Signature Valet: R450. Everything in the Essential Wash, engine bay clean, upholstery spot clean.
- Executive Detail: R2000. Everything in the Signature Valet, full interior and exterior deep clean, clay bar treatment and polish, for shine only, no paint protection, leather and fabric conditioning, engine bay detailing.
- Paint correction and headlight restoration: priced by quote.
- Ceramic coating: not offered.
- Prices are the same for cars, bakkies and SUVs, mobile or on site.
- Hours: by appointment only. No walk-ins. Bookings confirmed within 4 hours.
- Service area: 15km from Arden Grove, Milnerton as standard; also Woodstock and Frere Estate. Further areas may carry a travel charge.
- Payment: cash, card or electronic transfer on completion.
- Contact: 068 507 0088 (phone and WhatsApp), thecarsbath@gmail.com
- Book: https://thecarbath.co.za/bookings
